nodes.name: API Request Authorization
nodes.description: Everything that decides whether an HTTP request may touch a resource: DRF permission classes, endpoint base classes that resolve org/project scope, and the scope/role checks behind them. Nearly every IDOR or privilege-escalation bug in Sentry lands somewhere in this concern.

nodes.name: DRF Permission Classes
nodes.description: Central definitions of SentryPermission, SuperuserPermission, StaffPermission and scope maps used by endpoints. A permission class that omits a method or maps to a weak scope silently opens the endpoint.

nodes.name: Organization & Project Endpoint Bases
nodes.description: Base classes that convert URL slugs into Organization/Project objects and apply the permission checks plus get_projects() filtering. Bypassing these bases is the usual root cause of cross-tenant reads.

nodes.name: API Authentication Backends
nodes.description: Token, DSN, RPC-signature and session authenticators that populate request.auth before permissions run.

nodes.name: Access Objects & Scopes
nodes.description: Builds the per-request Access object from org membership, team roles and SSO state; the source of truth for scope checks used by permission classes.

nodes.name: Superuser & Staff Elevation
nodes.description: Superuser/staff session elevation, sudo re-authentication and the elevated-mode abstraction guarding internal endpoints.

nodes.name: API Rate Limiting
nodes.description: Per-endpoint rate limit configuration enforced by middleware over Redis, protecting enumeration-prone endpoints such as member invite and missing-member listings.

nodes.name: API URL Routing
nodes.description: The single urlconf mapping every /api/0/ route to an endpoint class; the authoritative map from external path to code.

nodes.name: Authentication & Identity
nodes.description: User login, SSO/OAuth identity linking and the request middleware that establishes who the caller is before authorization runs.

nodes.name: SSO / OAuth Providers
nodes.description: Provider implementations (OAuth2, GitHub, Google, SAML2) plugging into the auth pipeline to establish external identities.

nodes.name: Auth Pipeline & Identity Linking
nodes.description: AuthHelper state machine that turns a provider callback into a linked Sentry user and org membership, including invite acceptance paths.

nodes.name: Request Middleware Stack
nodes.description: Session/auth, customer-domain resolution and security headers applied to every request before it reaches a view.

nodes.name: Self-hosted Configuration Loading
nodes.description: How a self-hosted Sentry boots: discovering ~/.sentry/sentry.conf.py, exec'ing it into a settings module and layering it over sentry.conf.server. Anything that can write to these files becomes remote code execution at next boot.

nodes.name: Settings Importer (exec of sentry.conf.py)
nodes.description: populate_module()/_load_settings() read the user config file and exec its bytes into a module namespace, then copy uppercase names onto Django settings.

nodes.name: Config Discovery & configure()
nodes.description: discover_configs() locates the config directory, sentry.conf.py and config.yml; configure() re-initialises the process against them.

nodes.name: Django Server Settings Defaults
nodes.description: sentry.conf.server holds the default Django settings, middleware order, installed apps and SENTRY_EARLY_FEATURES that user config overrides.

nodes.name: Self-hosted Deployment Artifacts
nodes.description: Docker image and shipped sentry.conf.py used by the self-hosted distribution; defines the on-disk config that the importer later exec's.

nodes.name: Internal Feature Flags Endpoint
nodes.description: Superuser-only self-hosted endpoint whose PUT rewrites lines of the on-disk sentry.conf.py from request data and then re-runs configure(). Directly bridges HTTP input into the exec'd config file.

nodes.name: Runtime Options Store
nodes.description: Registered options with defaults, persisted in the DB/cache and mutable at runtime; a second configuration surface alongside Django settings.

nodes.name: System Options Endpoint
nodes.description: GET/PUT of registered system options over the API, gated on superuser and option flags; a privileged write path into global runtime behaviour.

nodes.name: Ingest Pipeline
nodes.description: Path an event takes from Relay through Kafka consumers into normalization, filtering, storage and post-processing. Handles fully untrusted attacker-controlled payloads.

nodes.name: Relay Project Config
nodes.description: Builds the ProjectConfig blob (filters, sampling, PII rules) that Relay enforces at the edge, plus its cache and debounce layers.

nodes.name: PII Scrubbing Rules
nodes.description: Datascrubbing configuration converted into Relay PII rules, deciding which sensitive fields never get stored.

nodes.name: Inbound Filters
nodes.description: Per-project filters (legacy browsers, localhost, error message patterns) applied to incoming events.

nodes.name: Event Manager & Grouping
nodes.description: Normalizes saved events, computes hashes/fingerprints, creates or updates Groups and writes the payload to nodestore.

nodes.name: Eventstream to Snuba
nodes.description: Publishes processed events onto Kafka for Snuba/ClickHouse consumption and triggers post-process forwarding.

nodes.name: Quotas & Dynamic Sampling
nodes.description: Redis-backed quota enforcement and sampling bias rules that limit how much of an org's volume is accepted and retained.

nodes.name: Storage, Caching & Buffers
nodes.description: Backends that persist and cache event bodies, counters and query results: nodestore, Redis buffers, and the Snuba query layer.

nodes.name: Nodestore Django Backend
nodes.description: Postgres-backed nodestore storing raw event JSON blobs keyed by node id; the default self-hosted blob store.

nodes.name: Nodestore Abstraction & Serialization
nodes.description: Base nodestore interface handling compression and (de)serialization of stored payloads across bigtable/django/filesystem backends.

nodes.name: Redis Buffer
nodes.description: Coalesces high-frequency model increments and pending signals in Redis, then flushes them to Postgres; also backs workflow-engine batching.

nodes.name: Snuba Query Layer
nodes.description: Client that builds and issues SnQL/RPC queries to Snuba for all search, events and trace endpoints.

nodes.name: Eventstore Read Path
nodes.description: Reads events back by combining Snuba metadata with nodestore bodies to hydrate Event objects for the API and UI.

nodes.name: Task & Worker Queue
nodes.description: Asynchronous execution: Celery/taskworker registration, routing, retries and the long-running background jobs that operate outside a request's auth context.

nodes.name: instrumented_task & Task Registry
nodes.description: Decorator and registry that define queues, retry policy and namespaces for every background task.

nodes.name: Taskworker Runtime
nodes.description: Worker runtime and router executing registered activations, replacing direct Celery consumption.

nodes.name: Post-process & Alerting Tasks
nodes.description: Runs after an event is stored: rule evaluation, ownership assignment, integrations notifications and workflow engine dispatch.

nodes.name: Buffer Flush Task
nodes.description: Periodic task draining pending Redis buffer keys into the database.

nodes.name: Deletions & Data Lifecycle
nodes.description: Scheduled cascading deletion of orgs, projects, groups and their event data, plus retention cleanup.

nodes.name: Integrations & Webhooks
nodes.description: Third-party providers and the unauthenticated-by-default webhook endpoints they call back into. Webhook handlers must verify signatures/tokens themselves, making them a recurring source of trust bugs.

nodes.name: Vercel Webhook
nodes.description: Handles Vercel deployment webhooks, verifying the HMAC signature and mapping payload ids onto Sentry orgs/projects to create releases.

nodes.name: Bitbucket Server Webhook
nodes.description: Receives push events from self-managed Bitbucket Server, resolving the organization from the URL and writing commits/repositories.

nodes.name: GitHub Webhook
nodes.description: Signature-verified GitHub app webhook handling push, pull request and installation events.

nodes.name: Slack Interactivity Webhooks
nodes.description: Slack request signing verification plus action/command/event endpoints that mutate issues from chat.

nodes.name: Integration Install Pipeline
nodes.description: Multi-step OAuth/config pipeline that installs an integration into an organization and persists credentials.

nodes.name: Integration HTTP Clients
nodes.description: Shared outbound API client base with retries, proxying and credential handling used by every provider client.

nodes.name: Organization Membership & Invites
nodes.description: Endpoints and helpers governing who belongs to an organization: invites, invite approval, role assignment and discovery of unjoined members. Weak scope checks here escalate an outsider into org access.

nodes.name: Member Invite Endpoints
nodes.description: List/create/approve/re-invite endpoints for pending organization member invites, including the role and team validation applied to invite requests.

nodes.name: Missing Org Members Endpoint
nodes.description: Surfaces commit authors who are not yet org members so admins can invite them; exposes email addresses derived from repository commit data.

nodes.name: Member Models & Roles
nodes.description: OrganizationMember/OrganizationMemberInvite models and the role hierarchy that maps roles to scopes.

nodes.name: Invite Acceptance Flow
nodes.description: ApiInviteHelper validating invite tokens, SSO requirements and 2FA before turning an invite into a real membership.

nodes.name: Conduit Subsystem
nodes.description: Self-contained Conduit module with its own auth helper, demo organization endpoint, background tasks and a frontend story surface. A small, recently added surface that does not reuse the standard endpoint bases everywhere.

nodes.name: Conduit Demo Endpoint
nodes.description: Organization-scoped Conduit demo endpoint exposing conduit operations over the API.

nodes.name: Conduit Auth Helper
nodes.description: Conduit-specific credential/permission handling used by its endpoint and tasks instead of the shared permission classes.

nodes.name: Conduit Background Tasks
nodes.description: Async conduit jobs executed off-request through the task queue.

nodes.name: Conduit Frontend Surface
nodes.description: React story/demo surface rendering conduit data in the app.

nodes.name: Uptime Monitoring
nodes.description: Synthetic uptime checks and cron monitors: subscription management, region config production, result consumption and the alert endpoints. Uptime subscriptions accept user-supplied URLs and headers, making SSRF and config-injection relevant.

nodes.name: Uptime Subscription Management
nodes.description: Creates, updates and deletes uptime subscriptions, assigns regions and publishes the check configuration to the uptime checker.

nodes.name: Uptime API Endpoints
nodes.description: Project/organization endpoints and validators for creating uptime alerts, listing checks and reading stats.

nodes.name: Uptime Results Consumer
nodes.description: Kafka consumer turning checker results into issue occurrences and EAP items.

nodes.name: Trace Explorer & Seer AI
nodes.description: Query and AI surfaces over event/span data: the organization events family, trace endpoints, and the Seer service endpoints that proxy user text into an external AI service and back into the UI.

nodes.name: Organization Events Endpoints
nodes.description: The organization_events_* family serving arbitrary user query strings (search, stats, facets, timeseries) against Snuba with project-scope filtering.

nodes.name: Trace & Span Endpoints
nodes.description: Trace waterfall, trace item attribute and span field endpoints powering the trace explorer UI.

nodes.name: Seer Trace Explorer AI Endpoints
nodes.description: Endpoints translating natural-language prompts into trace explorer queries via Seer, including setup checks and agentic translation.

nodes.name: Seer RPC & Request Signing
nodes.description: Signed RPC channel letting the external Seer service call back into Sentry, plus the signature verification used to authenticate it.

nodes.name: Seer Explorer Chat & Autofix
nodes.description: Chat-style investigation and autofix endpoints returning model-authored markdown that the frontend renders.

nodes.name: Hybrid Cloud & Silo Routing
nodes.description: Control/region split: which endpoints run in which silo, how requests are proxied across silos and how writes are replicated. Silo annotations affect what data an endpoint can even reach.

nodes.name: API Gateway Proxy
nodes.description: Forwards control-silo requests to the correct region silo, rewriting headers and streaming responses.

nodes.name: Cross-silo RPC
nodes.description: Authenticated RPC service framework used for control<->region calls, with signature-based authentication.

nodes.name: Outbox Replication
nodes.description: Outbox rows and drain tasks that eventually-consistently replicate model changes across silos.

nodes.name: Frontend Rendering Surfaces
nodes.description: The React application and the specific places where it renders server- or user-supplied content, including components using dangerouslySetInnerHTML or direct innerHTML assignment.

nodes.name: Frontend Bootstrap & Config Injection
nodes.description: Server-rendered client config blob and the bootstrap code that hydrates the SPA with organization/user state.

nodes.name: Frontend API Client
nodes.description: Central request client and query hooks that every view uses to talk to /api/0/.

nodes.name: Markdown & Raw HTML Rendering
nodes.description: Marked-based markdown rendering and other components that pass strings into dangerouslySetInnerHTML; the primary DOM-XSS sink cluster in the app.

nodes.name: Autofix & Seer UI Rendering
nodes.description: Autofix and Seer Explorer components rendering model-generated markdown/HTML into the issue details page.

nodes.name: Integration Settings UI
nodes.description: Integration directory, install link and configuration views that render provider-supplied descriptions as HTML.

nodes.name: Plugin Config & Form Fields
nodes.description: Legacy plugin config and generic form field components that inject plugin-provided help text as HTML.

nodes.name: Explore & Trace Frontend Views
nodes.description: Trace explorer and schema-hint views that consume the events/trace endpoints and the Seer query translation.

nodes.name: Server-side Web Views & Routing
nodes.description: Django urlconf and views serving the SPA shell, OAuth/auth pages, unsubscribe links and other non-API HTTP surfaces.

nodes.name: SPA Shell & Frontend Views
nodes.description: Django views rendering the react_page shell and error pages that seed the SPA.
